title: Technology Sector Update for 09/27/2018: IRDM,AMZN,MFGP,MCRO.L,CYBR,ACN - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +0.42%
AAPL +2.08%
IBM -0.03%
CSCO -0.02%
GOOG +1.27%
Technology stocks slipped slightly from their prior advance in late Thursday trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.5% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index also was rising nearly 0.5%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Iridium Communications ( IRDM ) climbed to a new all-time high on Thursday, rising over 7% to $21.97 a share, after saying it has been working with Amazon's ( AMZN ) web services partner network to develop a satellite-based cloud network providing global connectivity for internet-of-things applications. Iridium CloudConnect is expected to launch in 2019 and is expected to make Iridium's internet-of-things applications available through the Amazon web-services network to 80% of the earth still lacking cellular coverage.
In other sector news:
(+) CyberArk Software ( CYBR ) climbed almost 7% on Thursday, stopping only 2 cents shy of the stock's 52-week high of $78.36 a share after analysts at Morgan Stanley raised their investment grade for CyberArk shares to Overweight from Equal Weight and also increased their price target by $21 to $92 a share.
(+) Micro Focus International plc ( MFGP ) was more than 3% higher Thursday, staying within close range of its session high that followed the infrastructure software firm disclosing in a regulatory filing it repurchased 107,500 shares of its ordinary stock during Wednesday's regular trading session at the London Stock Exchange, paying a volume-weighted average price of GBP13.59 - or about $17.63 - per share. It also repurchased and then cancelled an additional 19,000 shares through Citigroup as its broker on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
(-) Accenture ( ACN ) was down almost 2% this afternoon after the technology consulting company Thursday said its fiscal Q4 net income and revenue beat Wall Street expectations but offered downbeat earnings FY19 guidance. Net income rose to $1.58 per share from $1.48 per share during the year-ago period following an 11% year-over-year increase in revenue to $10.1 billion, topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.02 per share and $100 million, respectively. For FY19, the company is projecting net income in the range of $6.98 to $7.25 per share, lagging the Street view by at least $0.02 per share.
